Strategy: Items larger than 50 target the midrange residual, halfway between the smallest and largest feasible residuals, while smaller items use Best Fit, so large items avoid both the tightest and emptiest bins. It differs from Best Fit only for large items. It may help by reserving extreme bins for items that truly need them, or fail because midrange bins may suit nobody well.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(-abs(r - (min(bins) + max(bins)) / 2) if item > 50 else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
